subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should the canonical WhatsApp reaction-read capability include passive plugin events only, agent-visible events, or bounded persisted history that powers the generic `reactions` action?
rationale: The issue combines distinct privacy, session-routing, retention, deletion, deduplication, and agent-turn semantics that cannot be safely selected from current code alone.

options.title: Events plus bounded history
options.body: Emit privacy-gated passive add/remove events and maintain a bounded SQLite reaction index for generic queries without waking agents by default.

options.title: Passive hooks only
options.body: Implement the narrower contract tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79996 and leave historical queries separately open.

options.title: Agent-visible events only
options.body: Route reactions into agent sessions without creating a plugin hook or durable historical query surface.

recommendation.title: Events plus bounded history
recommendation.body: Emit privacy-gated passive add/remove events and maintain a bounded SQLite reaction index for generic queries without waking agents by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current WhatsApp reaction policy and context-aware reaction behavior, making them the strongest history-based decision-routing candidate.
